title: The Fontaine operator at cusps of modular curves at infinite level
summary: We explicitly calculate Pan's geometric intertwining operator and the Fontaine operator on modular curves at infinite level via $q$-expansions, using Heuer's theory of cusps at infinite level. We prove that these two operators coincide on such expansions up to an explicit constant. As an application, we combine this result with $q$-expansion principles to provide a new proof of Pan's theorem that these operators are equal on the locally analytic vectors of completed cohomology of modular curves.
